description_en: Queries the diagnostic results of origin probing tasks
description_zh: 调用ListApplicationMonitorDetectResult接口查询源站探测任务的诊断结果
name: ListApplicationMonitorDetectResult

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 源站探测任务待查询时间段的起始时间。Unix时间戳格式，表示从1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 源站探测任务待查询时间段的截止时间。Unix时间戳格式，表示从1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: end_time

ApplicationMonitorDetectResultList.description_en: Details about the diagnostic result of the origin probing task
ApplicationMonitorDetectResultList.description_zh: 源站探测任务的诊断结果信息

items.description_zh: 源站探测任务的诊断结果信息

AcceleratorId.description_en: The ID of the GA instance on which the origin probing task runs
AcceleratorId.description_zh: 源站探测任务对应的全球加速实例ID

Content.description_en: The response content returned by the origin probing task
Content.description_zh: 源站检测任务诊断返回的响应内容

Detail.description_en:
The description of the diagnostic result. Valid values:

All forward nodes work well.: The origin server is normal.
Endpoint network error.: The origin server is abnormal. You must check whether the origin server is running as expected.
Public network error.: An Internet error occurred, which is a network error that occurred when the client connected to the acceleration region.
Ga internal error.: An internal error occurred. For example, an exception occurred when GA processed a request.
Ga has been deleted.: The current GA instance is deleted.
Ga state is not stable.: The current GA instance is in an unstable state, such as the Configuring state.
Ga has no listener configuration.: No listener is configured for the current GA instance.
Missing endpoint configuration.: No endpoint is configured.
Missing acceleration region configuration.: No acceleration region is configured.
Missing endpointgroup configuration.: No endpoint group is configured
Detail.description_zh:
源站探测任务的诊断结果描述。

All forward nodes work well.：未发现异常。
Endpoint network error.：源站异常，需要排查源站业务是否正常运行。
Public network error.：公网错误，一般指客户端到加速地域的网络错误。
Ga internal error.：内部错误，例如，全球加速实例内部处理请求异常。
Ga has been deleted.：当前全球加速实例已经被删除。
Ga state is not stable：当前全球加速实例状态不稳定，例如处于配置中。
Ga has no listener configuration.：当前全球加速实例无监听配置。
Missing endpoint configuration.：缺少终端节点配置。
Missing acceleration region configuration.：缺少加速地域配置。
Missing endpointgroup configuration.：缺少终端节点组配置

DetectTime.description_en: The time when the diagnosis of the origin probing task ends
DetectTime.description_zh: 源站检测任务诊断结束时间

DiagStatus.description_en:
The diagnostic result of the origin probing task. Valid values:

success: The origin probing task succeeded.
failed: The origin probing task failed
DiagStatus.description_zh:
源站探测任务的诊断结果。

success：源站探测任务成功。

failed：源站探测任务失败

ListenerId.description_en: The ID of the listener on which the origin probing task runs
ListenerId.description_zh: 源站探测任务对应的监听实例ID

Protocol.description_en:
The network transmission protocol that is used by the listener. Valid values:

tcp: TCP.
udp: UDP.
http: HTTP.
https: HTTPS.

UDP listeners do not support probing
Protocol.description_zh:
监听的网络传输协议类型。

tcp：TCP协议。

udp：UDP协议。

http：HTTP协议。

https：HTTPS协议。

UDP协议类型的监听不支持探测

StatusCode.description_en: The error code returned by the origin probing task
StatusCode.description_zh: 源站检测任务诊断返回的错误码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
